how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-western-plaguelands-02.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:5230:obj:0: Bring the Filled Felstone Field Bottle to Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark, ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:5230:details:0: You fill the bottle with enough of the cauldron's poisonous concoction for a suitable sample to be studied.
rows.quest:5230:details:1: BWith the poison in hand, it is time to return to Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark to complete the mission.
rows.quest:5230:completion:0: Well done ⟦1⟧ - it should take Apothecary Dithers no time at all to analyze this and devise a counter agent to introduce into the cauldron. If we are able to pump out enough of it into the air, we might be able to weaken all the Scourge present here.
rows.quest:5230:completion:1: BThis will no doubt be an ongoing ordeal; we will need to continually hit these cauldrons and introduce our reagents into their mix. Still, if we can keep it up, we will have a huge advantage over Scourge when the time comes for battle!
rows.quest:5231:obj:0: Go to Dalson's Tears in ⟦E1⟧ to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Dalson's Tears Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.
rows.quest:5231:details:0: One of the plague cauldrons is located in the field of a former farmhouse now referred to as Dalson's Tears. No tears will be shed this day, ⟦2⟧; we must strike at this cauldron and gain access to it!
rows.quest:5231:details:1: BGo to Dalson's Tears, almost due north of Andorhal, and eliminate the cauldron lord there. It should have a key like the last one did, allowing you inside the cauldron's innards. Use this bottle to obtain a sample from inside the cauldron; each cauldron has its own distinct brew of toxins it uses.
rows.quest:5231:completion:0: The skeletal key found on the cauldron lord easily slides into a keyhole and then disappears, allowing you permanent access to it. Crude, viscous ichors pulsate through twisted tubes within the cauldrons underpinnings.
rows.quest:5231:completion:1: BThere is a small spigot that the bottle fits well enough under, allowing you to draw a sample for Shadow Priestess Vandis back at the Bulwark.
rows.quest:5232:obj:0: Bring the Filled Dalson's Tears Bottle to Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark, ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:5232:details:0: You carefully fill the bottle with enough of the cauldron's ichors for what you consider to be suitably sized sample.
rows.quest:5232:details:1: BWith the poison in hand, it is time to return to Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark to complete the mission.
rows.quest:5232:completion:0: Ah, there is plenty in here for study. Well done, ⟦3⟧!
rows.quest:5232:completion:1: BFor now, the next step is in our hands. We'll need to produce a list of reagents that, when combined with what is already in the cauldron, will act as its counter.
rows.quest:5232:completion:2: BThe only way we will be able to introduce this is by placing the reagents into the cauldron directly. Apothecary Dithers will have more information on that, so be sure to speak with him as soon as possible.
rows.quest:5233:obj:0: Go to the Writhing Haunt in ⟦E1⟧ to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Writhing Haunt Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.
rows.quest:5233:details:0: Two cauldrons have been successfully opened; while you'll be able to access them indefinitely, we still want to open up the other two that remain. This will provide all of us with more options to introduce the counter agent!
rows.quest:5233:details:1: BThis time, you'll be hitting the Writhing Haunt's cauldron. It is almost due east of Andorhal, relatively close to the ruined city walls; again, eliminate the cauldron lord present there for its key. Use this bottle to obtain the sample from the cauldron.
rows.quest:5233:completion:0: The cauldron lord's key unlocks the access panel to this cauldron and then disappears, much like the other keys have for the previous ones you've dealt of. A putrid smelling substance churns violently beneath the platform of the cauldron.
rows.quest:5233:completion:1: BThere is a small spigot that the bottle fits well enough under, allowing you to draw a sample for Shadow Priestess Vandis back at the Bulwark.
rows.quest:5234:obj:0: Bring the Filled Writhing Haunt Bottle to Shadow Priestess Vandis at The Bulwark, ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:5234:details:0: You delicately top off the empty bottle; a sample of the foul substance that churns under the platform of the cauldron now oozes back and forth inside the fragile glass container.
rows.quest:5234:details:1: BWith the poison in hand, it is time to return to Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark to complete the mission.
rows.quest:5234:completion:0: Another finely executed mission, ⟦5⟧! This makes three cauldrons available to us to turn against the Scourge. If Kel'Thuzad's necromantic dominance over these lands wasn't as strong as it currently is, I'd dare say you'd shut them down completely!
rows.quest:5234:completion:1: BApothecary Dithers will have a report on what this cauldron - as well as the other cauldrons subverted - will require to deliver our counter agent to the plague. With that, the time has come to bring the last cauldron of the west under our influence!
rows.quest:5235:obj:0: Go to Gahrron's Withering in ⟦E1⟧ to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Gahrron's Withering Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.
rows.quest:5235:details:0: The last cauldron that remains is located on a farm now called Gahrron's Withering. It is guarded by some of the Scourge's tougher minions - specifically, wraiths and ghosts. They are not to be trifled with, ⟦6⟧.
rows.quest:5235:details:1: BGahrron's Withering is far to the east of the Bulwark, close to where the ⟦E2⟧ begin; again, eliminate the cauldron lord present there for its key. Here is your empty sample bottle; bring it to me filled. May the shadows cloak you in safety for this dangerous mission, ⟦7⟧.
rows.quest:5235:completion:0: Cauldron Lord Soulwrath's key disintegrates as it touches the lock on the access panel at the base of the cauldron's platform. A slight clanking noise is heard within, and the access panel swings open to reveal more viscous toxins within the cauldron's framework.
rows.quest:5235:completion:1: BThere is a small spigot that the bottle fits well enough under, allowing you to draw a sample for Shadow Priestess Vandis back at the Bulwark.
rows.quest:5236:obj:0: Bring the Filled Gahrron's Withering Bottle to Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark, ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:5236:details:0: You carefully close the spigot in the control panel, watching the cauldron's putrid ichors drip into the empty bottle.
rows.quest:5236:details:1: BWith the poison in hand, it is time to return to Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark to complete the mission.
rows.quest:5236:completion:0: Congratulations ⟦8⟧, you've unlocked the last cauldron for us! Apothecary Dithers will soon know what this cauldron requires as far as reagents needed for the mix.
rows.quest:5236:completion:1: BAs for you, I am sure that High Executor Derrington will want to thank you personally for the assistance you've given us. Without you, our struggle against the Scourge would have been nearly insurmountable. I thank you, mighty ⟦9⟧.
rows.quest:5237:completion:0: ⟦10⟧, your successful re-engineering of the cauldrons is a tremendous victory for us!
rows.quest:5237:completion:1: B<The high executor clears his throat and begins to bellow loudly.>
rows.quest:5237:completion:2: BLet all within my presence hear: for service to the ⟦E3⟧ and to the ⟦E4⟧ as a whole above and beyond what was expected - in the face of overwhelming odds and incredible danger, might I add - I give ⟦11⟧ this, and I extend upon ⟦12⟧ our undying gratitude as a true hero of the ⟦E4⟧. Huzzah!
rows.quest:5238:completion:0: ⟦13⟧, your successful re-engineering of the cauldrons is a tremendous victory for us!
rows.quest:5238:completion:1: B<The commander clears his throat and begins to bellow loudly.>
rows.quest:5238:completion:2: BLet all within my presence hear: for service to the Kingdom of ⟦E5⟧ and to the ⟦E6⟧ above and beyond the call of duty - in the face of overwhelming odds and incredible danger, might I add - I give ⟦14⟧ this, and I extend upon ⟦15⟧ our undying gratitude as a true hero of the ⟦E6⟧. Cheers, I say!

rows.quest:5342:completion:0: Wonderful! Now only I hold the power and fortune of house ⟦E8⟧!
rows.quest:5342:completion:1: B<Alexi throws a large bag at you.>
rows.quest:5342:completion:2: BAnd keep the change, you filthy animal.
rows.quest:5344:obj:0: ⟦E7⟧ to the Bulwark - ⟦E4⟧ territory - and assassinate Alexi ⟦E8⟧. Take his head and return to Weldon ⟦E8⟧.
rows.quest:5344:obj:1: BBe warned, Alexi will probably be well protected by ⟦E4⟧ filth.
rows.quest:5344:details:0: With the deeds recovered, there is but one thing left to do. Alexi must be killed. With him dead, I need not ever worry about an unscrupulous gang of mercenaries seeking my head.
rows.quest:5344:details:1: BIt's a simple task. Alexi hides under the protection of the ⟦E4⟧ - at the Bulwark.
rows.quest:5344:details:2: BNo, I do not expect you to just walk up and kill him, I want his head! How you get it... well, that part is up to you. That type of behavior is below one of my noble upbringing.
rows.quest:5344:completion:0: A glorious day it is! Finally, the pockmark of house ⟦E8⟧ eliminated and my fortune secure!
rows.quest:5344:completion:1: BTake this and leave my sight, peasant.

rows.quest:5461:obj:0: ⟦E7⟧ to the ⟦E9⟧, to the ruins of Stromgarde. Search Stromgarde for a Keepsake of Remembrance. If you find such an item, return with it to Magistrate Marduke.
rows.quest:5461:details:0: The undead fear life just as the living fear death. It is not unusual for a sentient undead being to completely destroy all remnants of his or her previous life after having turned.
rows.quest:5461:details:1: BUnfortunately, in order to create an artifact capable of reverting Ras Frostwhisper to a mortal, we must have a keepsake from his years among the living.
rows.quest:5461:details:2: BYou must venture to the ruined city of Stromgarde, Frostwhisper's home, and search for such an item. May luck be with you, ⟦19⟧.
rows.quest:5461:completion:0: I had doubted the possibility of such an item existing. This certainly opens up an incredible opportunity - one we must not squander.
rows.quest:5461:completion:1: BPrepare yourself, ⟦20⟧, for what I am about to ask of you will take you into the depths of hell.
rows.quest:5462:obj:0: ⟦E7⟧ to Light's ⟦E10⟧ in ⟦E2⟧ and seek out Leonid Barthalomew the Revered. Show him the Keepsake of Remembrance and tell him all that you have discovered.
rows.quest:5462:details:0: Upon tainted soil, the keepsake must be attuned.
rows.quest:5462:details:1: BIt is rumored that ⟦E11⟧ is where Frostwhisper succumbed to the Lich King. Upon those bloodied grounds he gave his life - freely and with motive - to become one of the undying.
rows.quest:5462:details:2: BIt is those grounds that must be found.
rows.quest:5462:details:3: BThere is one, an undead dissenter of the Scourge, freed by the Banshee Queen but loyal to the cause of the Argent Dawn. Find him: Leonid Barthalomew the Revered. He may know more. Seek out Light's ⟦E10⟧, ⟦21⟧.
rows.quest:5462:completion:1: BYour quandary stirs up memories that I had hoped would never resurface.
rows.quest:5465:obj:0: Return to Magistrate Marduke in ⟦E12⟧. Show him the Soulbound Keepsake.
rows.quest:5465:details:0: Return to Marduke with the keepsake, ⟦23⟧. He will instruct you in its use.
rows.quest:5465:completion:0: I was certain that you would be joining me as another hapless spirit.

rows.quest:5533:obj:0: Speak with Alchemist Arbington at Chillwind Point, ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:5533:details:0: On the island of ⟦E12⟧ lies Scholomance - a wretched center of Scourge necromancy and evil. Our enemy dwells within, conducting unspeakable acts of depravity on unwitting victims... at least, we surmise as much. A door bars the way, and try as we might no entry is to be had without a proper key.
rows.quest:5533:details:1: BAlchemist Arbington is well versed on Scholomance, and has an idea how to obtain a key. You have proved your worth to me, and now I entrust this task to you. Speak with him on this matter.
rows.quest:5533:completion:0: Well met, ⟦42⟧. I've dedicated a fair portion of my recent studies to the Scholomance, and I believe I know a means by which you can acquire a key... one that will let you past the front door.
rows.quest:5533:completion:1: BI can only imagine what horrid sights are to be seen inside, ⟦43⟧. I don't know how you heroic types do it sometimes...
rows.quest:5537:obj:0: Bring 15 Skeletal Fragments to Alchemist Arbington at Chillwind Point, ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:5537:details:0: The key to Scholomance is called a Skeleton Key. It must be forged from the remains of a skeleton - several actually - and hardened by only the strongest of metals within a suitable mold. A signet of power from a being who naturally can open the portal to Scholomance will make the key ultimately function.
rows.quest:5537:details:1: BFirst thing's first though, ⟦44⟧. We'll need skeletal fragments for the key's forging. Skeletons inside Andorhal should yield what we need, but the ones outside the walls might work too.
rows.quest:5537:completion:0: This'll work, ⟦45⟧! My turn now - I will imbue these with a suitable temper that will allow them to survive the intense forging process they will eventually go through.
rows.quest:5537:completion:1: BThe next step will be to get an appropriate mold for the key. I know a goblin blacksmith in ⟦E13⟧ that has in the past made molds for similarly macabre items. He works for whom goblins usually work for - the highest bidder.

rows.quest:5803:details:0: Araj the Summoner lords over Andorhal from the ruined city's heart. We know that he was the former leader of Scholomance before claiming the city as his own. To finish the key, we will need his signet - called a scarab - mounted as the head of the key.
rows.quest:5803:details:1: BMake your way into the heart of Andorhal, and break his hold on the city now that he is drawn into the open. Once destroyed, seize his scarab from his fallen phylactery!
rows.quest:5803:completion:0: Yes, this is it! I... again, I'm absolutely amazed at the depths of your cunning and bravery. It simply boggles the mind the lengths you are willing to go in order achieve victory.

rows.quest:5861:details:0: ⟦50⟧, you have done all that I have asked thus far. Only one step remains in your quest of redemption.
rows.quest:5861:details:1: BYou must deliver the items you have collected to Taelan. Unfortunately, Taelan and his ⟦E15⟧ Crusaders will attack you on sight.
rows.quest:5861:details:2: BThere is only one way in which to deliver my message and that is through a guise of deception.
rows.quest:5861:details:3: BTo the south you will find Uther's tomb. An old and trusted confidant of mine, Myranda, now resides there - seek her out. Show her the items and she will assist you.
rows.quest:5861:completion:0: I was Tirion's most trusted advisor when he held rank as Lord of Mardenholde. I openly dissented the verdict passed by the Order of the Silver Hand and was banished for my insolence.
rows.quest:5861:completion:1: BHe has been through much heart ache and disappointment in his life, ⟦51⟧. Are you prepared to right the wrongs set upon the Fordrings?
rows.quest:5862:obj:0: Speak to Myranda to gain the ⟦E15⟧ Illusion. ⟦E7⟧ to Hearthglen while under the ⟦E15⟧ Illusion and deliver Tirion's Gift to Highlord Taelan Fordring.
rows.quest:5862:obj:1: BHearthglen is to the north, Taelan should be inside of Mardenholde Keep.
rows.quest:5862:details:0: I am what you would call, an illusionist. Though I may be able to create an illusion to allow you entry into Hearthglen, be warned; my powers have their limitations.
rows.quest:5862:details:1: BShould you travel too far from these lands, the effects of the illusion will cease. The spell itself takes a great amount of concentration and power from me, and thus, I can only sustain the effect for a short time.
rows.quest:5862:details:2: BSpeak to me again when you are ready.
rows.quest:5862:completion:1: B<Taelan opens the box and begins to examine its contents.>
rows.quest:5862:completion:2: BThis... this cannot be true. But all that you have shown me...
rows.quest:5862:completion:3: B<Taelan falls to one knee, his heartbeat quickens. The fury of ages is about to be loosed upon this town.>
rows.quest:5903:obj:0: Use the Empty Termite Jar on the Termite Mounds in ⟦E2⟧. After you've gathered 100 Plagueland Termites, return to Nathaniel Dumah at Chillwind Camp in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:5903:details:0: I've tried many times to rout out the ⟦E16⟧ through force alone, but to no avail. So, as an alternative, I've decided to make their lives more difficult.
rows.quest:5903:details:1: BIf you are willing to help, I want to infest that lumber mill with the most terrible species of termites ever found.
rows.quest:5903:details:2: BIn Plaguewood, near the once-great ⟦E11⟧, there is a breed that survived the plague and the Scourge combined. Find their mounds and fill this jar with them, so we can prepare them to be unleashed on the Crusade.
rows.quest:5903:completion:0: These will do nicely, ⟦52⟧. Thank you.
rows.quest:5903:completion:1: BIf you're ready, we can get on with the next step.
rows.quest:5904:obj:0: Find someplace suitable in the center of the Northridge Lumber Mill in ⟦E1⟧ to place the Barrel of Plagueland Termites.
rows.quest:5904:details:0: Now that we have the termites, take this steel reinforced barrel to the Northridge Lumber Mill south of Hearthglen--you'll find it to the west of the road that leads you up to the town.
rows.quest:5904:details:1: BOnce there, place the barrel in the center of the lumber mill; find someplace suitable, like on a crate and then open it. The termites should do their work from there and make the mill useless to the Crusade.
rows.quest:5904:completion:0: The termites are obviously getting restless as you place the barrel on top of the crate.
rows.quest:5944:obj:0: Escort Taelan Fordring out of Hearthglen.
rows.quest:5944:details:0: For so long, I have been a puppet of the Grand Crusader. What reason was there to fight against what the ⟦E16⟧ had become? It has been decades, yet the memories of my father; those precious memories, they are what have kept me alive.
rows.quest:5944:details:1: BI have dreams, stranger. In these dreams my father is with me. He stands proudly at my side as I am inducted into the Order. We battle legion of Scourge, side by side. We bring honor to the ⟦E6⟧, to Lordaeron.
rows.quest:5944:details:2: BI want not to dream anymore.
rows.quest:5944:completion:0: The death of my son at the hands of these monsters will not pass without incident. Take solace in knowing that the Order is reborn.
rows.quest:5944:completion:1: BI now take my place as Highlord of the new Order of the Silver Hand.
rows.quest:5944:completion:2: BThese possessions of my past - they are all that I have to offer for all that you have done. Please, take these as a symbol of my gratitude; all have served me well over the years.
rows.quest:5944:completion:3: BMay we meet again, in better times, and reminisce of days long past... battles hard fought... dreams redeemed.
rows.quest:6004:obj:0: Kill 2 ⟦E15⟧ Medics, 2 ⟦E15⟧ Hunters, 2 ⟦E15⟧ Magi and 2 ⟦E15⟧ Knights before returning to Kirsta Deepshadow in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:6004:details:0: I was sent as a scout to do some damage and gauge the strength of Hearthglen's defenses. Some people in the ⟦E6⟧ feel the little town has more than historical importance. It's not my job to question what that importance is, but regardless, I'm in no shape to continue until I rest up.
rows.quest:6004:details:1: BIf you're willing, I'd pay handsomely for some help. Start south of here at their camp near the small bulwark they've set up. If you prove strong enough, maybe I could get your help with my main goal.
rows.quest:6004:completion:0: Well done, ⟦53⟧. I'm amazed you dealt with them so quickly. Thank you.
rows.quest:6004:completion:1: BI have yet to meet anyone that approves of the ⟦E16⟧ and their methods. I believe in the Light as much as anyone else in ⟦E5⟧, but they've demonstrated that they only want to kill anyone not loyal to their movement... even innocents.
rows.quest:6023:obj:0: Kill Huntsman Radley and Cavalier Durgen before returning to Kirsta Deepshadow in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:6023:details:0: My real mission was to weaken the ⟦E16⟧'s outlying forces and then infiltrate Hearthglen to gauge their numbers. I'm still in no shape to do it on my own, so perhaps I could ask you to aid me again, ⟦54⟧? From what information I gathered before being discovered, the Crusade has two important members that are the backbone of their forces outside the town: Huntsman Radley and Cavalier Durgen. Kill them, and we're making progress. They should be along Hearthglen Pass outside the town proper.
rows.quest:6023:completion:0: Thank you, ⟦55⟧. You've been more help than I could have hoped for. The air here just seems to suck my will. I feel tired, and I can tell I'm not getting any better the longer I'm here.
rows.quest:6023:completion:1: BI'm not really sure how I'm going to infiltrate Hearthglen itself and report on how strong the ⟦E16⟧'s presence is.
rows.quest:6023:completion:2: BBut that's another matter, before you leave, here, take this... as payment for your help. Thank you again.
rows.quest:6025:obj:0: Enter Hearthglen and find a high vantage point from which you can see the town and gauge the ⟦E16⟧'s forces, then return to Kirsta Deepshadow in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:6025:details:0: What? Really? You want to know more? But you've already done so much for me, ⟦56⟧. I couldn't possibly ask you to enter Hearthglen itself on my behalf.
rows.quest:6025:details:1: BAre you sure, ⟦57⟧? Hearthglen is much more dangerous than the Pass--I cannot provide you any protection or even information about what you might face.
rows.quest:6025:details:2: BWell, if you really are willing to help, then enter the town and find a high place to gain a good view of the town. From there you can gauge their numbers and report them back to me. But be careful....
rows.quest:6025:completion:1: BI'll return to Elling... I mean ⟦E5⟧ as soon as I can. Here, take this coin, it's the least I can do for you. You're a credit to your people, ⟦59⟧. Thank you and good luck.
rows.quest:6184:obj:0: ⟦E7⟧ to Chillwind Camp in the ⟦E1⟧ and meet up with your contact, Flint Shadowmore.⟦60⟧
rows.quest:6184:details:0: The only information we have thus far, then, is that ⟦E17⟧ Marris may have been slain by this Blightcaller. We assume the Blightcaller is the same fiend that disposed of my agents.
rows.quest:6184:details:1: BFlint Shadowmore, another SI:7 operative, is stationed at the ⟦E6⟧ encampment of Chillwind Point in the ⟦E1⟧. Seek him out; he will debrief you on the current situation in the Plagues and give you an assignment.
rows.quest:6184:completion:0: The first mission will be straight up, ⟦62⟧. You go in, you come out. Recon...
rows.quest:6389:obj:0: Release the Plagueland Termites in the Northridge Lumber Mill, then return with the Barrel of Plagueland Termites to Nathaniel Dumah at Chillwind Camp in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:6389:details:0: You look around the lumber mill for something suitable to open the barrel with. You find a crowbar that looks like it will do the trick.
rows.quest:6389:details:1: BYou set your feet and pray that you'll be able to get out of the mill before the termites get to you.
rows.quest:6389:completion:0: Haha! Thank you, ⟦63⟧! You've done it! My father's spirit can now rest and I can live in peace.
rows.quest:6389:completion:1: BThank you again. If there is anything I can do for you, please, just ask.
rows.quest:6390:obj:0: Release the Plagueland Termites in the Northridge Lumber Mill, then return with the Barrel of Plagueland Termites to Mickey Levine at the Bulwark in ⟦E18⟧.
rows.quest:6390:details:0: You look around the lumber mill for something suitable to open the barrel with. You find a crowbar that looks like it will do the trick.
rows.quest:6390:details:1: BYou set your feet and pray that you'll be able to get out of the mill before the termites get to you.
rows.quest:6390:completion:0: Thank you, ⟦64⟧. Here, take this coin. I'm sorry it's not more, but try to take some joy in helping destroy the ⟦E16⟧'s efforts!
